releases.notes:
Support for **Minecraft 26.2**.

## What changed

26.2 ships **unobfuscated** and Yarn has no builds for it, so the mod moves to the official Mojang names. Every replacement was checked against `server-26.2.jar`'s own class list rather than inferred.

Notable API changes handled:
- `Permission.Level` no longer exists — the gamemaster check is now `source.permissions().hasPermission(Permissions.COMMANDS_GAMEMASTER)`
- the spawnable-surface test `isSideSolidFullSquare()` becomes `isFaceSturdy()`
- the floor-button state is now `defaultBlockState().setValue(ButtonBlock.FACE, AttachFace.FLOOR)`
- `setBlock()` now requires explicit flags
- `MinecraftServer.isDedicated()` becomes `isDedicatedServer()`

No gameplay or command changes — `/spawnproof` behaves exactly as in 1.0.x.

## Requirements

| | |
|---|---|
| Minecraft | 26.2 |
| Fabric Loader | 0.19.3+ |
| Fabric API | 0.156.0+26.2 |
| Java | 25 |

## Verification

Tested on a dedicated Fabric 26.2 server — `/spawnproof 128` ran to completion with no exceptions and tick time steady at ~3 ms against the 50 ms budget.

The button-face rewrite is the line behind the historic wall-button bug, where buttons landed only where a step-up sat to the south. That failure mode neither crashes nor skews the reported count, so placement coverage was confirmed **visually** rather than from logs. It is uniform.

releases.notes:
## SpawnProof v1.0.0

Places buttons on spawnable surfaces to prevent mob spawning. Perfect for Wither skeleton farms in the Nether.

### Features
- Two speed modes: Safe (10/sec) or Fast (200/sec)
- Preview with stack breakdown before placing
- Survival mode (uses inventory) and OP mode (unlimited)
- Supports all button types (stone, wood, Nether wood)
- Configurable radius 8-128 blocks

### Commands
- `/spawnproof` - Preview with default radius (128 blocks)
- `/spawnproof <radius>` - Preview with custom radius
- `/spawnproof stop` - Stop current task
- `/spawnproof help` - Show commands

### Requirements
- Minecraft 1.21.11
- Fabric Loader 0.18.4+
- Fabric API 0.140.2+
